name: k8s_secret
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Secret.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this secret.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this secret to a cloud provider account. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this secret belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the secret is created in.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Kubernetes secret type (e.g. Opaque, kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson, kubernetes.io/tls).

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Secret entries with base64-encoded values, keyed by name. Populated by the server from string_data if not set directly.

attributes.name: string_data
attributes.description: Secret entries with plaintext values, keyed by name. Write-only: the server never returns this field on read.

attributes.name: immutable
attributes.description: Mark the secret immutable (its data cannot be changed after creation).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the secret.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the secret.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: k8s_secret_id
attributes.description: ID of this secret, for reference by dependent resources.
